Keep every complete subject in the middle 60% of its cell with at least 20% blank margin on ALL FOUR sides. No mark or body part may cross cell boundaries. NO grey shading, gradients, hatching, dithering, distressed edges, speckles, thin wrinkles, hair strands, readable text, initials, numerals, logos, borders or watermark. NO anime, manga, chibi, spiky hair, huge eyes, heroic pretty faces or cartoon anatomy.
